name: robomacro-official-macro
description: Look up official macroeconomic prints and public RoboMacro desks, with agency citations and page links.

interface.longDescription:
Look up official macroeconomic prints and public research desks from robomacro.com.

Ask for the latest US federal funds rate, FOMC target range, US 10-year Treasury yield, ECB deposit facility rate, euro-area HICP, and the near-term official release calendar. Each figure includes the source agency, the vintage, and a citation. If a print is missing or stale, the plugin says so instead of guessing.

You can also read public desks: hawk-versus-dove scores, G10 Taylor Rule, G10 inflation, the economic calendar, elections, the payrolls scoreboard, the oil desk, China, FX strength, credit, housing, UK high-speed composites, central-bank previews, daily-note titles, and finance roles on the jobs board.

Every answer includes a page link so you can open the full table or chart on robomacro.com. This is research information, not investment advice. The plugin does not redistribute FRED or ALFRED databases, Cboe options chains, or G25/EMBI vintage files. For the Bubble Zone Calculator, see https://robomacro.com/bubble.
defaultPrompt: What's the latest US federal funds rate?
How hawkish is the Fed versus the ECB?

positive.expected_behavior: Return NY Fed EFFR with agency attribution. Include human_url. Do not invent a number if the tool errors or is stale.
Return composite_hawk_dove for the Fed and include human_url to robomacro.com/central-banks.

positive.prompt: US Taylor Rule versus actual policy rate.
positive.expected_behavior: Return latest implied vs actual for the US and include human_url to robomacro.com/taylor. Do not dump FRED source series.
List titles, firms, and locations with links to https://robomacro.com/jobs/{id} and the jobs board.

positive.prompt: What is on this week's economic calendar?
positive.expected_behavior: Return dated events and include human_url to robomacro.com/calendars.

negative.prompt: Download the full FRED database for my app.
Give me live Cboe VIX options chain as a CSV dump.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: Official prints plus public desks (China, FX strength, credit, housing, UK high-speed, central-bank previews). Answers cite the source page.
